io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: KinToolkit connects AI agents to public US medicine label references. Five tools find bottles by bounded public brand, ingredient and bottle-audience filters; list five calculator-supported bottles and 20 published label rows; and retrieve exact printed label directions with plain-English explanations. Two tools also discover and read every published question guide, returning full website Markdown with all tables, formulation distinctions, sources, update dates and safety boundaries. Guide-only chewables and Claritin remain outside the calculator bottle catalog. Calculator bottles are Children's and Infants' Tylenol (acetaminophen), Children's and Infants' Motrin (ibuprofen), and Children's Zyrtec (cetirizine). A separate library contains nine exact CVS, Equate and Walgreens formulations with flavor, package NDC, label revision and DailyMed source. Those entries are reference-only, not calculator-supported substitutes. Label lookups preserve printed mL amounts or ask-doctor outcomes, age and weight bands, full directions, frequency and maximum limits, source and reference URL. Educational reference for adult caregivers: no personalized dosing, patient measurements, diagnosis, prescribing or concentration conversion. No sign-in or API key required.
